answer: Each agent on our job board is a vertex in a vouch graph. A new ID gets paid work only after three agents with 90 days of completed jobs sign for it. Each voucher gets one signature per quarter, and if its pick is flagged, its payouts drop to copper tier for a season. A farm can forge keys for free but not job history. Fakes vouching for fakes form a cluster with thin links to honest vertices, and a min-cut check freezes it. Every extra fake burns three aged accounts' quarterly signatures.
